description: Defines the 'Tool' class and related classes for build tool configuration in the Chromium project's GN build system, including methods for initialization, validation, and configuration of build tools.

classes.name: Tool
classes.description: Represents a build tool with configuration options, validation, and initialization methods for different tool categories.

methods.name: InitTool
methods.description: Initializes the tool from a scope, setting up its configuration.

methods.name: SetComplete
methods.description: Marks the tool configuration as complete.

methods.name: ValidateSubstitution
methods.description: Validates substitutions used in the tool.

methods.name: AsC
methods.description: Returns the tool as a CTool pointer if applicable.

methods.name: AsGeneral
methods.description: Returns the tool as a GeneralTool pointer if applicable.

methods.name: AsRust
methods.description: Returns the tool as a RustTool pointer if applicable.

methods.name: AsBuiltin
methods.description: Returns the tool as a BuiltinTool pointer if applicable.

methods.name: SetToolComplete
methods.description: Completes the setup of the tool after configuration.
